title: HR IT Software Engineer Intern
description:
Job Details:
Job Description:
As an Information Technology Undergraduate Intern, you will play a vital role in supporting Intel's IT operations and solutions. You will be actively involved in hands-on projects, collaborating with cross-functional teams to solve real-world challenges and improve processes. Your contributions will help enhance technological efficiencies and support the development of innovative solutions that drive business performance.
Global IT is dedicated to delivering impactful technology solutions that support Intel's business operations worldwide. The group focuses on advancing enterprise systems, optimizing IT workflows, and ensuring seamless integration of technologies to enable Intel's continued success and innovation in the marketplace.
The primary responsibilities for this role will include, but are not limited to:
Designs, builds, and integrates applications and platforms to support Intel's business needs and application packaging deployment that meets IT standards.
Collaborate with IT teams to analyze, design, and implement solutions to improve enterprise systems and processes.
Assist in troubleshooting and resolving technical issues to ensure operational efficiency.
Participate in testing and validating IT systems, applications, and processes to support performance reliability.
Contribute to the documentation of system processes and procedures for knowledge sharing and future reference.
Work on assigned projects and tasks, ensuring timely delivery and quality outcomes.
A successful candidate will have proven experience demonstrating the following skills and behavioral traits:
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with attention to detail.
Strong communication and collaboration skills to work effectively in a team environment.
Enthusiasm for learning and adapting to new technologies and methodologies.
Ability to manage time effectively and balance multiple tasks or projects in a dynamic environment.
Qualifications:
Minimum Qualifications :
Minimum qualifications are required to be initially considered for this position.
Pursuing a Bachelor's or licenciatura in System Engineering or related fields.
Experience in one or more programming languages such as .NET, MS-SQL, Postgres, Node JS or React, Python, Java, or C++.
Experience in using common software tools or programming languages relevant to IT environments.
Knowledge of the Software Development Lifecycle and/or Test Methodologies.
Knowledge of the Agile Software Development Methodology.
Advanced English level.
Must have unrestricted - permanent right to work in Costa Rica.
Take the next step in your professional journey by applying for this exciting internship opportunity. Join Intel's Global IT team to gain valuable experience, refine your skills, and make an impact in a global organization that thrives on innovation.
Job Type:
Student / Intern
